subject: Provisional slate: Runtime & platform hires + comp band calibration (Q4 request)
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Provisional slate: Runtime & platform hires + comp band calibration (Q4 request)

Hi Laura —

Following up from the staffing sync last week. Attached is a provisional hiring slate for the runtime/platform org for Q4 (spreadsheet: hc_slate_Q4_v2.xlsx) and a short comp-band reference. High-level ask: approval to open 3 reqs and permission to extend offers up to the following bands if candidates meet bar:

- Senior Runtime Engineer (IC4): base band midpoint $180k; target total comp up to $230k with equity/sign-on
- Platform SRE (IC3-IC4): base band midpoint $155k; target total comp up to $195k
- Compiler/Inference Engineer (IC4): base band midpoint $185k; target total comp up to $240k (higher equity expectations)

Notes and asks:
- These are provisional — I want to keep flexibility for exceptional candidates (esp. compiler role).
- Suggested sign-on maxes: $30k for Senior Runtime, $25k for SRE, $40k for Compiler.
- Budget: Marcus, I included cost calculations on tab 3 (expected burn, hire timing).
- Recruiting: Marissa, please engage TalentBridge for the Compiler role (specialist search).

Attached: hc_slate_Q4_v2.xlsx, comp_band_reference.pdf, candidate_carlos_vega_resume.pdf (early pipeline — Carlos Vega is a referral; included for context).

Requesting: please confirm (A) approval to open the reqs, (B) sign-off limits for offers (bands + sign-on) or guidance on where to escalate. If you'd rather we route the Compiler role to exec approval for any offer over the midpoint, say so and we’ll flag it.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Runtime & Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional slate: Runtime & platform hires + comp band calibration (Q4 request)

Thanks — quick reactions inline.

On Tue, 24 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following up from the staffing sync last week. Attached is a provisional hiring slate for the runtime/platform org for Q4...

I reviewed the sheet. Overall ok to open the reqs, but a couple of asks before I give final band/sign-on permission:

1) Role seniority: For the Platform SRE, you list IC3-IC4. Please separate into two reqs if you truly expect both seniority levels — we shouldn't bundle them.
2) Midpoint/headroom: The Compiler band looks aggressive vs. comp comp (we've had market movement, but verify comp survey data). Marcus, can you share the benchmarking source used for those midpoints?
3) Sign-on exceptions: I'm okay with the proposed sign-ons up to the stated amounts only if recruiting documents the business case (e.g., immediate impact, hard-to-find skill). Any offer above midpoint + 10% must route to me for approval.

Also, bring me one concrete candidate (resume + short write-up) before we extend a cash-heavy package. I see Carlos' resume — ok to track him, but treat as early pipeline.

If you can split the SRE req and supply benchmarking links, I'll sign off on opening the reqs and allow recruiting to run the searches.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional slate: Runtime & platform hires + comp band calibration (Q4 request)

Thanks for the slate, Nikhil. I agree with Laura's asks and offer the following edits so recruiting has a clear gate: 

- Split SRE into two reqs (Platform SRE IC3; Senior Platform SRE IC4) — I'll accept IC3 offers up to midpoint + 5% without escalation; IC4 offers > midpoint + 10% route to Laura.
- Compiler role: given the scarcity, allow hiring team to go up to midpoint + 25% for total comp but require a two-line business justification in the GH req before offer. If equity is the lever instead of cash, include target % in the req.
- For sign-on and equity exceptions, Marcus will confirm budget headroom. Marcus?

Also added a practical step: Marissa, please ask TalentBridge to provide 3 CVs for the Compiler role before we run any paid outreach; we want to evaluate signal first.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional slate: Runtime & platform hires + comp band calibration (Q4 request)

Quick confirmation on budget side: I've reviewed the numbers in tab 3. We have budget capacity to support the three reqs in Q4 with the caveat that any offer packages exceeding midpoint + 15% must be approved by Finance (me) and will require a reforecast to the December spend plan.

Next steps I want captured in one email thread: 
- Nikhil: split the SRE into two reqs and update the HC sheet (deadline EOD Thu).
- Marissa: engage TalentBridge for a shortlist for Compiler (3 CVs) and open GH reqs after Laura's sign-off.
- Recruiting: document any pay or equity exceptions in the GH req as "business case".

Marissa, please coordinate with Hannah at TalentBridge (cc'd in separate outreach) and attach the comp_band_reference.pdf to the reqs.

I'll greenlight offers up to midpoint + 15% for now; anything above that, loop me and Laura.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
